QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` ... inits a mutex and calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed, buffer_alloc_free_mutexed)`" and "this module is the only in-tree caller of `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` according to the index."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names memory_buffer_alloc as the sole in-tree caller of the runtime setter, installing its allocators from its init function.
